commits.summary: Keep new verification jobs under the day they were submitted
commits.body:
At the user's request (2026-11-22), layout.WRITE goes from "flat" to "shards": a new job is written to verification/jobs/YYYY/MM/DD/ID.json and its result to verification/results/YYYY/MM/DD/ID/. Both folders had passed the 1,000 entries GitHub's web view lists (1,092 jobs, 1,122 results). Jobs written before stay flat, each result beside its job, and every reader already resolves both layouts through layout.py. VERIFY_LAYOUT=flat restores the old layout for one command.

The pipeline's tests assumed flat paths. test_pipeline.py gains Repo helpers (job_path, job_rel, indexed, collected) that resolve through layout.py, submit() takes an env, and every hand-built jobs/ or results/ path goes through them. test_layout.py's new-job check follows WRITE. test_capture.py plants its earlier results where the job's result goes. The README and layout.py docstring say what changed.

The setup record for the Spring and Java data briefs now carries the outcome of the three historical Spring build jobs. A2 (Spring Security #14196) built at all three revisions with each side's tests passing and an offline rerun; A3 (Framework #36911) built at both, with the landed PropertyTests passing and failing 9 of 18 on the parent as expected. A4 (Framework #23893) could not build: repo.spring.io/plugins-release answered 401 for two build plugins, which is recorded as refused and left for a decision. Jar digests, runtime classpaths and the snapshot dependencies the Framework 7.1 build pulled are recorded, and a wrong statement about that build's repositories is corrected.

The brief's Spring preflights were replayed inline with throwaway probes on JDK 21.0.13: A2's 32 configurations give identical reachable sets and 14/16 decisions per prefix for legacy text and builder on the three built jars and the 6.3.0 release; A3's table matches on the built jars and on each Property.java ahead of spring-core 7.0.4; A4's stored date, error count and displayed value match on each revision's registrar ahead of 5.2.0.RELEASE, on JDK 21 and 8.
